text:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick thread - FoxgloveAI wants to list Foxglove-6B on our marketplace + a joint SI bundle with HelixSI. They sent a "Foxglove Research & Sharing License (FRSL)". Need to nail hosting vs download and partner redistribution.
Marta (Legal): Can someone paste the redistribution clause? I'll do an initial pass. @qa-bot please run a license-diff against Apache2.
Liu - FoxgloveAI: pasted: 
```
Section 4 - Redistribution: Weights and model binaries may be hosted for commercial use with attribution. Redistribution of weight files or binaries to third parties requires express written permission. Redistribution to named enterprise partners can be granted via separate addendum.
```
Kai (Product): Product note: HelixSI needs to pre-bundle quantized weights into deployment images for customers. If FRSL requires per-customer permission we'll need a partner sublicense or a standard redistribution addendum template. Also need test vectors to validate runtime.
Aya - HelixSI: HelixSI prefers a partner-level redistribution carveout (Redwood + HelixSI) otherwise per-customer paperwork slows everything down. We also need a certification-only bundle under NDA for hardware testing.
Marta (Legal): Two realistic options: (1) Partner sublicense addendum granting Redwood + HelixSI rights to distribute to paying customers (scalable). (2) Per-customer written permission template/addendum. I'll draft both and include indemnity & export control language.
qa-bot: license-diff complete. FRSL vs Apache2 -> conflict: FRSL restricts redistribution. Recommend ask for partner sublicense or per-deal redistribution addendum. No obvious export-control flags; advise provenance attestation.
Sam (Partnerships): Marketing asks: Foxglove wants a public Host-only SKU and a hidden Enterprise "download+SI" SKU if we secure redistribution. They also want a co-branded launch in ~6 weeks. Can we support that?
Kai (Product): Timeline: need weights for perf/quant in 10 business days. Perf slot: week of 3789998000. Target Dedicated SLO: 55ms p99 on 8k for quantized FOxglove-6B. If we can't promise download for Dedicated, we'll mark Dedicated as "host-with-managed-private-deploy" only.
Liu - FoxgloveAI: We can sign a partner addendum for Redwood+HelixSI. Prefer limited indemnity and an audit window. We'll provide provenance docs and test vectors.
Aya - HelixSI: We'll accept partner addendum. Also request a certification NDA channel so our QA team can receive int8 and fp16 slices for validation.
Marta (Legal): I'll circulate two redlines today: partner-sublicense draft and per-customer appendix template. Also include a short certification-only NDA template.
Sam (Partnerships): Action items: Marta to send redlines; Liu to upload provenance + test vectors; Kai & HelixSI to sync on quant formats and perf plan; Marketing to tentatively hold a 6-week embargo (contingent on partner addendum).
qa-bot: provenance-check: requested artifacts pending (model hash + training provenance).
Kai (Product): Noted. If partner addendum lands, prioritize cert bundle to HelixSI by wk2 so they can integrate.
Sam (Partnerships): I'll update after redlines. Thanks everyone :rocket:
